import json, os, re
item = _items[0]["json"]
slug = item["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
spath = os.path.join(root, "script.json")
if not os.path.exists(spath):
    raise RuntimeError("no script.json in " + root + " — run the Script stage first")
with open(spath) as fh:
    script = json.load(fh)
chars = {c["id"]: c for c in script.get("characters", [])}
DEFAULT_TTS = "google/gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview"
def ok_model(m):
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9/_.:\-]{2,80}", m or ""))
def ok_voice(v):
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_\-:.]{2,40}", (v or "").strip()))
override = item.get("tts_model") if ok_model(item.get("tts_model")) else None
regen = set(item.get("regen_ids") or [])
lines = []
for scene in script.get("scenes", []):
    for shot in scene.get("shots", []):
        sid = shot["id"]
        pending = []
        if shot.get("narration"):
            pending.append({"text": shot["narration"], "voice": script.get("narrator_voice", "charon"),
                            "instructions": script.get("narrator_instructions", ""), "model": DEFAULT_TTS})
        k = 1
        for d in shot.get("dialogue") or []:
            k += 1
            c = chars.get(d.get("character", ""), {})
            pending.append({"text": d.get("text", ""), "voice": c.get("voice", "kore"),
                            "instructions": c.get("tts_instructions", ""), "model": c.get("tts_model", DEFAULT_TTS)})
        seq = 0
        for entry in pending:
            seq += 1
            lid = sid + "_L%02d" % seq
            out_rel = "audio/lines/" + lid + ".mp3"
            exists = os.path.exists(os.path.join(root, out_rel))
            if exists and sid not in regen:
                continue
            text = (entry.get("text") or "").strip()[:3800]
            if not text:
                continue
            voice = (entry.get("voice") or "").strip().lower() if ok_voice(entry.get("voice")) else "kore"
            model = override or (entry.get("model") if ok_model(entry.get("model")) else None) or DEFAULT_TTS
            instr = (entry.get("instructions") or "").strip()[:500]
            # Gemini TTS documented style-prompt pattern: "Say <style>: <text>".
            # Bare text kept for the fallback retry — some instruction strings make
            # the upstream return HTTP 200 with an empty audio stream (502 surfaced).
            styled = ("Say " + instr + ": " + text)[:4000] if instr else text
            fmt = "pcm" if "gemini" in model.lower() else "mp3"  # Gemini TTS only outputs PCM
            lines.append({"slug": slug, "shotId": sid, "lineId": lid, "text": text, "styled_text": styled,
                          "voice": voice, "tts_model": model, "fmt": fmt, "outPath": out_rel})
if not lines:
    raise RuntimeError("All voiceover audio already exists. Enter shot ids in the form to force regeneration.")
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "slug": slug, "lines": lines}}]

import base64, datetime, json, os, subprocess
items = _items
if not items:
    raise RuntimeError("no audio lines received")
first = items[0]["json"]
slug = first["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, "audio", "lines"), exist_ok=True)
for it in items:
    d = it["json"]
    raw = os.path.join(root, "audio", "lines", d["lineId"] + "." + d.get("fmt", "mp3"))
    with open(raw, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(base64.b64decode(d["audioB64"]))
    if d.get("fmt") == "pcm":
        # Gemini TTS returns raw 24 kHz 16-bit mono PCM — wrap it into mp3
        mp3 = os.path.join(root, "audio", "lines", d["lineId"] + ".mp3")
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "s16le", "-ar", "24000",
                        "-ac", "1", "-i", raw, "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "4", mp3], check=True)
        os.remove(raw)
with open(os.path.join(root, "script.json")) as fh:
    script = json.load(fh)
sil = "/tmp/n8nfilm_sil.mp3"
if not os.path.exists(sil):
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=24000:cl=mono",
                    "-t", "0.25", "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "6", sil], check=True)
durations = {}
silent_shots = []
for scene in script.get("scenes", []):
    for shot in scene.get("shots", []):
        sid = shot["id"]
        # collect all of the shot's line files by prefix — numbering-agnostic
        lines_dir = os.path.join(root, "audio", "lines")
        prefix = sid + "_L"
        line_files = sorted(os.path.join(lines_dir, f) for f in os.listdir(lines_dir)
                            if f.startswith(prefix) and f.endswith(".mp3"))
        out = os.path.join(root, "audio", sid + ".mp3")
        if not line_files:
            # Shot has no narration or dialogue — synthesize silence spanning its
            # full visual duration so downstream stages treat every shot uniformly.
            try:
                hint = float(shot.get("duration_hint_sec") or 0)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                hint = 0.0
            dur = min(15.0, max(2.0, hint)) if hint > 0 else 5.0
            subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "lavfi",
                            "-i", "anullsrc=r=24000:cl=mono", "-t", "%.3f" % dur,
                            "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "4", out], check=True)
            silent_shots.append(sid)
        else:
            lst = "/tmp/n8nfilm_mix_" + sid + ".txt"
            with open(lst, "w") as fh:
                for j, p in enumerate(line_files):
                    if j:
                        fh.write("file '" + sil + "'\n")
                    fh.write("file '" + p + "'\n")
            subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", lst,
                            "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "4", "-ar", "24000", "-ac", "1", out], check=True)
        pr = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", out],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        durations[sid] = round(float(pr.stdout.strip()), 3)
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
pf = os.path.join(root, "project.json")
proj = json.load(open(pf)) if os.path.exists(pf) else {}
proj.update({"status": "voice_ready", "updated_at": now})
proj.setdefault("stages", {})["voiceover"] = {"status": "done", "done_at": now, "durations": durations, "silent_shots": silent_shots}
with open(pf, "w") as fh:
    json.dump(proj, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "slug": slug, "durations": durations, "silent_shots": silent_shots}}]
